games.name: Rocket League
games.note: Its Easy Anti-Cheat refuses Rosetta's Wine (code 206) and loads its Linux module on the Linux engine. Its publisher executable, Launcher.exe, is a .NET program and the engine's Wine has no Mono: the game starts with the Easy Anti-Cheat bootstrapper Launcher.exe would start, with the same arguments.

games.name: ELDEN RING
games.note: Easy Anti-Cheat, as Rocket League's. It only has Direct3D 12, which D3DMetal renders and DXMT does not. Steam's launch already starts its bootstrapper, start_protected_game.exe.
